comments.author: MilaKunisWatermelon
comments.body:
People are really letting Claude do way too much work for their games. I’m fine with using AI to make a game, but don’t be so fucking lazy that you let Claude do all of it. It should be a tool to assist you, not the creative engine behind the entire game.

Use it to build processes for game creation, don’t use it as the process for game creation.

replies.author: kosimus
replies.body:
No idea why any kind of "laziness" would even be a factor. Use it whatever way you want, as long as it lets you achieve a result you like.
If you use it a the entire process for your game's creation, and the result if good, then it's fine.

replies.author: iFixReality
replies.body: I'm working on a few games with Claude right now. All except one are from my own imagination. The one that isn't was an experiment where I asked Claude opus to come up with a game it wanted to make. It came up with 3 ideas and the one it liked best we started making. it's not something I'd ever have thought of but the concept is intriguing if not wholly unique, and we are now fairly far along in its production. It can be interesting to see what the thing comes up with and I'm curious if anyone is making a similar game for similar reasons. That said, it's taken a lot of work to move it beyond the basic slop output and I've taken over more of the creative direction as we've proceeded.

replies.author: MilaKunisWatermelon
replies.body:
The one in which you allowed Claude to come up with the idea might seem original now but when hundreds of other people do the same thing in telling Claude to come up with an idea, it’s going to become unoriginal very quickly.

Claude isn’t a random number generator. If you give it similar prompts, you’ll get similar results, albeit not exactly identical. That’s why when people have AI generate an image of a blonde woman, it usually comes out looking like Sydney Sweeney.

If the game is just for you and nobody else, there’s no problem with that. But if you’re trying to sell it, you’ll have a hard time separating your game from all of the others that will be similar.
